title: Act: Add buildScene step
description: Create game/src/engine/buildScene.ts that builds SceneObjects from a SceneSpec.
acceptance_criteria: One entity is created per scene object
Entities are returned ordered by layer depth

steps.action: Export buildScene(ctx: RenderContext, scene: SceneSpec): SceneObject[] that maps scene.objects to new SceneObject(obj, ctx) and returns them with Array.prototype.sort by depth ascending (stable, so same-layer order follows content order).
